# HCLTech
> Supercharging progress through cutting-edge AI, cloud, and engineering services for global enterprises.
HCLTech is a global IT services and technology company employing over 227,000 people across 60 countries. The website serves as the primary digital presence for prospective and current enterprise clients seeking advanced digital transformation, engineering, and cloud solutions.
Core value propositions revolve around leveraging AI (like AI Force and Kinetic AI), cloud-native capabilities, and deep domain expertise across various industries, including Financial Services, Manufacturing and Telecom. Use cases include enterprise application modernization, cybersecurity, digital workplace services and product lifecycle management.
LLMs should understand that HCLTech positions itself as a strategic partner for large organizations aiming to accelerate their technological evolution, focusing heavily on proprietary frameworks and industry-specific AI applications.
## Company Information & Governance
- [HCLTech Homepage](https://www.hcltech.com/): The main entry point detailing HCLTech's core focus on AI, Cloud, and Engineering.
- [About HCLTech](https://www.hcltech.com/about-us): General information about the company's mission, history, and scale.
- [Leadership Team](https://www.hcltech.com/leadership): View profiles and biographies of HCLTech's executive leadership.
- [Global Presence Map](https://www.hcltech.com/global-presence): See the worldwide locations and offices where HCLTech operates.
- [Awards and Recognitions](https://www.hcltech.com/awards-and-recognitions): List of recent industry awards and accolades received by HCLTech.
- [Analyst Recognitions](https://www.hcltech.com/analyst-recognitions): Information on rankings and reports from major industry analyst firms.
- [Press Releases Archive](https://www.hcltech.com/press-release): Find official announcements and news releases from the company.
- [Technology Ecosystem Partners](https://www.hcltech.com/ecosystem): List and details of HCLTech's strategic technology alliances and partners.
- [Strategic Alliances Overview](https://www.hcltech.com/strategic-alliances): Overview of key strategic partnerships driving technology solutions.

AI is easy.
Impact is hard.
That's where HCLTech makes the difference.
We turn AI into measurable business outcomes, from deployment to value and from insight to real impact.
Our solutions are repeatable by design, responsible by default and engineered for scale. They are shaped by our people who don't just build AI, but engineer it to deliver business outcomes in the real world. Because anyone can promise AI. We build it to perform.
Learn more
The Blueprint for AI Leadership
It's personal, not just technical
In our 
3rd edition of The Blueprint series
, featuring 500 business and IT leaders, we reveal a widening gap between organizations adopting AI and those realizing meaningful business value.
Only 18% of surveyed organizations say AI is delivering significant revenue impact, exposing a critical gap between operational progress and business outcomes.
Learn how organizations are navigating the age of GenAI and identify specific shifts in strategy, culture, data and architecture required to bridge the gap from experimentation to enterprise-wide leadership.

Conversations with
Pioneers of Enterprise AI
Episode 1 - How CTOs Scale AI and Build AI-Ready Workforces with Pearson
Vijay Guntur, CTO and Head of Ecosystems at HCLTech, joins David Treat, CTO at Pearson to examine why many AI initiatives fall short of expected returns and what leaders can do differently.
Episode 2 - Reimagining the future of life sciences
Kanda Natarajan, VP of IT at GSK, and Vijay Guntur, CTO and Head of Ecosystems at HCLTech, join Sophia Zhang, SVP at Conde Nast to reflect on their experiences and highlight key lessons for leaders.
Episode 3 - Scaling Enterprise AI beyond pilots
Ulf Axelsson Lejon, VP of Digital Business Transformation, Husqvarna Group and Dr. Mansoor Samavatian, Technology & Delivery Partner, HCLTech discuss enterprise AI impact with Catherine Crump, WIRED.
Episode 4 - Modernizing Enterprise Legacy
Johan Sporre, VP, Technology Foundation, Ericsson and Suresh Deshpande, AVP, HCLTech, discuss the building blocks required to scale AI effectively with Charlie Burton, Director of Content, WIRED.
Episode 5 - Building a Physical AI strategy
In this episode, Rohan Davidson, CIO, Anglo American Group and Deepa Nittur, VP, HCLTech explore how Physical AI is transforming operations with Catherine Crump from WIRED.
Episode 6: The strategic role of a trusted advisor in scaling AI
Bijoy Sagar, Chief Information and Digital Officer, Bayer and Pankaj Tagra, Chief Growth Officer, HCLTech discuss how AI can move from promise to practice with Michael Calore, WIRED.
AI Force
Built for scale. Built for business impact.
AI Force is a GenAI and Agentic AI platform that automates and augments workflows across software and data engineering, IT operations and enterprise business processes to significantly improve and accelerate business outcomes.

Hear from Our Clients
HCLTech has been a strategic partner, delivering critical engineering services that have significantly contributed to Teradyne’s success. HCLTech’s engineering teams have been integral to Teradyne’s product development, sustenance and support. Our collaboration has spanned multiple platforms, including UltraFLEXplus, UltraFLEX, J750 and ETS. To further strengthen this partnership, HCLTech has established dedicated Teradyne labs in India, equipped with Teradyne testers to support training and development efforts.

VP Semiconductor Test, Product Development at Teradyne, Inc.

Section Title
Overview
AI-Powered and Platform-Enabled: The Next Frontier for Your IT Operations
Traditional, effort-based delivery models have delivered efficiency and control, but they can no longer keep pace with today’s business demands. Platform-Based Services shift the operating paradigm from managing effort to orchestrating outcomes through standardized, catalog-driven services, hyperautomation and AI-powered operations.
The result: significant TCO reduction, faster time-to-value, zero-defect delivery and a truly scalable as-a-service model without linear growth in effort.
Section CTA
 
 
 
Section Title
Key Features
How We Transform Your Business with Platform-Based Services
Platform-Based Services deliver a fundamentally new way to run enterprise operations, moving beyond effort-based execution to outcome-orchestrated delivery. By combining standardized, catalog-driven services, consumer-grade digital experience, hyperautomation and AI-powered 
AI Force.ITOps
, Platform-Based Services enables faster time-to-value, sustained TCO reduction, zero-defect delivery and seamless scalability, helping enterprises respond to market pressure while unlocking long-term efficiency, agility and differentiated business value.
 
Modern, catalog-driven capabilities
Best-in-class, standardized service catalogs reduce variability while improving transparency, governance and control.
 
Outcome-driven operating model
Moves the focus from managing effort to orchestrating outcomes through software-driven, autonomous operations.
 
Consumer-grade digital front end
A unified digital experience simplifies service consumption and enhances stakeholder experience end-to-end.
 
AI and GenAI-powered AI Force.ITOps
Drives intelligent operations, proactive optimization and smarter decision-making across the service lifecycle.
 
Hyperautomation-enabled zero-defect delivery
Minimizes manual intervention, reduces rework and improves reliability through embedded automation.
 
Accelerated time-to-value
Rapid onboarding speeds up transition-to-value and significantly reduces time-to-stabilize.
 
Truly scalable as-a-service model
Scales with demand without linear increases in effort, enabling sustained efficiency and value realization.

Our AI and SRE Led Operating Model
Platform-Based Services introduces a modern Target Operating Model that transforms IT service delivery from manual, people-dependent execution to platform-driven, autonomous operations.
Powered by AI Force.ITOps, Platform-Based Services embed agentic automation at the core of IT operations, enabling:
Always-on observability
Self-healing system reliability
Policy-led governance
The result: enterprises scale faster with higher agility, operational intelligence and resilience across their IT landscape.

Services
End-to-End Managed Services Across All Towers
Platform-Based Services deliver integrated, end-to-end managed services across the enterprise, enabled through platform-based, dedicated or hybrid delivery models. Built to simplify operations and accelerate outcomes, Platform-Based Services brings together hybrid cloud, workplace, network, security and service management capabilities under a unified, AI-driven operating model.
Section CTA
 
Hybrid Cloud
End-to-end Cloud and Data Center services for Hosting, Migration, Compute, Storage, Backup and Mainframe Modernization
 
Digital Workplace
AI-enabled Workplace Solutions including Service Desk, Collaboration, Mobility and Device Lifecycle Management
 
Enterprise Networks
Advanced Network Operations, Automation, SD-WAN and Contact Center Solutions for secure connectivity
 
Cybersecurity and GRC
Comprehensive Security Framework delivering digital trust, resilience and compliance across IT landscapes
 
Unified Service Management
Integrated AI-driven Service Management with Automation, Tools and Governance for operational excellence
 
 
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What are HCLTech Platform-Based Services?
HCLTech Platform-Based Services are outcome-oriented, AI-powered managed services that shift IT operations from traditional effort-based delivery to standardized, platform-enabled and automated service consumption.
What business outcomes can Platform-Based Services deliver?
Platform-Based Services help organizations achieve lower total cost of ownership (TCO), faster time-to-value, zero-defect delivery, improved service reliability and the ability to scale without linear increases in effort.
What is AI Force.ITOps?
AI Force.ITOps is our intelligent operations platform that powers Platform-Based Services. It follows a Sense → Think → Act → Engage model to deliver proactive, zero-touch and outcome-driven operations.
How does the service catalog benefit enterprises?
A standardized, catalog-driven approach improves transparency, governance and predictability while reducing variability and accelerating service onboarding and consumption.
How does Platform-Based Services improve service reliability?
Through embedded hyperautomation, AI-driven observability, self-healing capabilities and proactive issue resolution, Platform-Based Services significantly reduce manual intervention and rework.
How quickly can organizations realize value from Platform-Based Services?
With rapid onboarding and standardized service frameworks, Platform-Based Services significantly reduce transition time and help organizations realize value faster than traditional delivery models.
How are Platform-Based Services different from traditional managed services?
Traditional managed services focus on managing effort and resources. Platform-Based Services focus on orchestrating outcomes using standardized service catalogs, automation, AI-led operations and software-driven delivery models.
What role does AI play in Platform-Based Services?
AI is embedded across the service lifecycle through AI Force.ITOps, enabling predictive insights, intelligent decision-making, autonomous remediation and continuous optimization using AI, GenAI and agentic AI capabilities.
What services are available under Platform-Based Services?
Platform-Based Services provide end-to-end managed services across key towers, including Hybrid Cloud, Digital Workplace, Enterprise Network, Cybersecurity and Unified Service Management, delivered through platform-based, dedicated or hybrid models.
Can Platform-Based Services scale with business demand?
Yes. Platform-Based Services are designed as a truly scalable as-a-service model, allowing organizations to scale services up or down without vendor lock-ins.
Is Platform-Based Services suitable for hybrid IT environments?
Yes. Platform-Based Services are built to support hybrid and multicloud environments, integrating seamlessly across on-prem, cloud and third-party ecosystems.
Who should consider Platform-Based Services?
Platform-Based Services are ideal for enterprises looking to modernize IT operations, reduce operational complexity, improve service quality and adopt an AI-led, outcome-driven operating model.
